biotools.summary: scBOND is a bidirectional cross-modal translation framework designed for single-cell multiomic data. It infers single-cell DNA methylation profiles (scDNAm) from gene expression (scRNA-seq) and vice versa, capturing context-dependent regulatory patterns.
